params.name: targetObj
params.description: Range, element (header/footer/body/table/paragraph/anchored or inline picture/section/subsection/style sheet), 4D Write Pro document, or a section/subsection object.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Resets one or more named attributes on targetObj using variadic attribName arguments; if targetObj is a section or subsection, all attribName arguments may be omitted to reset every attribute at once.
overloadMerges.note: Doc syntax lines 1 (targetObj; ...attribName, cardinality min 1) and 2 (sectionOrSubsection {; ...attribName}, cardinality min 0) are one semantic overload: the same variadic-attribName mechanism, differing only in whether the target's specific type (section/subsection) permits omitting all names. Cardinality set to min 0 (the permissive case); the required-when-generic-target nuance is captured in constraints/jointConstraints, not enforced structurally.

params.name: targetObj
params.description: Range, element (header/footer/body/table/paragraph/anchored or inline picture/section/subsection/style sheet), 4D Write Pro document, or a section/subsection object.

params.name: attribColl
params.description: Collection of attribute names to reset.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Resets multiple named attributes on targetObj at once using a Collection of attribute names (attribColl); if targetObj is a section or subsection, attribColl may be omitted to reset every attribute at once.
overloadMerges.note: Doc syntax lines 3 (targetObj; attribColl, required) and 4 (sectionOrSubsection {; attribColl}, optional) are one semantic overload: the same Collection-based mechanism, differing only in whether the target's specific type (section/subsection) permits omitting attribColl entirely. Set optional:true (the permissive case); see constraints for the required-when-generic-target nuance.

constraints: When targetObj is not a section nor a subsection, at least one attribName (or a non-empty attribColl) must be provided; omitting all of them raises an error in that case.
When targetObj is a section or a subsection, all attribName/attribColl arguments may be omitted, which resets every attribute at once.
If the attribute being reset was not defined on the target element, the command does nothing.
Resetting a style sheet object's attributes removes them from the style sheet, unless it is the default ('Normal') style sheet, in which case the default value is applied instead.
